Forecast the size of later versions

Source: R/evolution.R
vp_forecast_size.Rd

Forecast the number of links of later versions from their number of features. The growth law is fitted on the first train versions; a cruder rule ("links per feature stay as in the last known version") is given beside it.

Usage

vp_forecast_size(history, train)

Arguments

history

A history: the versions of a model, from vp_read_history() or vp_history(), oldest first.

train

How many of the first versions to fit the growth law on (at least 3, and fewer than the versions of the history).

Value

A tibble with version, links, observed, growth_law, same_ratio and the errors of both, as shares.

See also

Other evolution: vp_attachment(), vp_auc(), vp_changed_links(), vp_co_change(), vp_community_history(), vp_compare(), vp_disruptions(), vp_edit_type(), vp_eras(), vp_feature_churn(), vp_feature_states(), vp_flip_flops(), vp_growth(), vp_history_apply(), vp_history_changes(), vp_history_sizes(), vp_hub_stability(), vp_interaction_changes(), vp_life_cycle(), vp_link_lifetime(), vp_prediction_table(), vp_rename(), vp_rename_candidates(), vp_ripple(), vp_state_moves(), vp_top_movers(), vp_version_distance()

Examples

gens <- c("miband1", "miband2", "miband3", "miband4", "miband6")
history <- vp_history(
  vp_example(paste0(gens, "_realized.uvl")),
  versions = gens,
  or_graph = TRUE
)
vp_forecast_size(history, train = 3)
